title: 01 USB-C INPUT AND ROLE DETECTION
purpose: USB-C 16-pin interface providing VBUS power input, CC1/CC2 5.1k pull-downs for 5V UFP role detection, and dual-channel high-speed ESD protection for USB D+/D-.

parts.role: Dual-channel high-speed ESD protection array for USB_DP and USB_DM
5.1k pull-down on CC1 for UFP (sink) advertisement
5.1k pull-down on CC2 for UFP (sink) advertisement
10uF input bulk decoupling on VBUS rail
100nF high-frequency bypass capacitor on VBUS rail

qa.formula: Rd = 5.1 kOhm +/- 10% (USB Type-C Spec Table 4-29: Default USB Power / 1.5A / 3.0A)
qa.result: 5.1 kOhm selected (1% tolerance 0402 resistor), sinking 5.1k ensures standard Type-C source attaches 5V VBUS correctly.
qa.source: USB Type-C Cable and Connector Specification Release 2.1, Section 4.5.2.2

qa.formula: C_in_max = 10 uF (USB 2.0 section 7.2.4.1 hot-plug inrush limit to prevent VBUS droop > 330 mV at attach)
qa.result: C1 = 10 uF 0603 16V X5R + C2 = 0.1 uF 0402 50V X7R = 10.1 uF nominal, with DC bias derating (~6.8 uF effective at 5V), strictly <= 10 uF.
qa.source: USB 2.0 Specification Section 7.2.4.1 Inrush Current Limiting

qa.item: ESD Protection Clamping and Line Capacitance
qa.formula: C_line <= 3.5 pF for USB 2.0 Full/High Speed signal integrity
qa.result: USBLC6-2SC6 line capacitance is 3.5 pF max (I/O to GND), ESD rating +/-15kV air, +/-8kV contact (IEC 61000-4-2 Level 4).
qa.source: STMicroelectronics USBLC6-2SC6 Datasheet DocID10188 Rev 8 Table 4
